Raft Cosmic EV – Andheri East (Sterling Centre)

If you are living in Mumbai and planning to start a delivery job with platforms like Swiggy, Zomato, Instamart, or Blinkit but don’t know where to get a bike, Raft Cosmic EV is a very good option for renting an electric scooty.

The rental process here is simple and beginner-friendly with minimal paperwork.
Currently, the initial payment is around ₹2550, which includes ₹2300 as a refundable bike deposit and ₹250 for KYC charges.

For documentation, you need:

PAN Card
Address Proof (If you are living on rent, then a Rent Agreement copy is required)

Once your KYC is completed, the paperwork is done quickly, and in most cases, you get the scooty on the same day.

Right now, they provide the Raft Warrior EV scooty, which is suitable for delivery jobs. It has enough space in the front for a delivery bag and can also be used at the back. The speed is limited to 25 km/h (do not try to unlock it).

Battery performance has improved recently. Earlier it gave around 80–90 km range, but now with the upgraded battery, it gives approximately 100–110 km per full charge.

Weekly rent: ₹1225 (auto-deducted from your delivery ID)

If deduction fails, payment details are shared via WhatsApp
